name: Dyson style
touchpoints: the round screen on the cordless vacuums (the power mode by name in its colour, Eco green, Auto blue, Boost red, the run time left in minutes and seconds, a battery), the exploded views Dyson uses to explain its machines (parts pulled apart along one axis, leaders to their names), the green light on the cleaner head that shows dust on hard floor, and the dyson.com Specifications panel (a label, a large Light number with a small unit, a hairline)

sample.topic: The prototype review of the cordless platform at Vizney Appliances, a fictional appliance maker: three models (C45 Compact, C60 Standard, C90 Large) built and tested together one build a week, builds 32 to 41 (Sep 14 – Nov 21, 2026). Build 37 was the last design review and design freeze is Fri, Dec 11. Seven targets a model (run time in Eco, Auto and Boost, suction and noise in Boost, edge pick-up, weight), the weight of every part against its budget, the dust left after one pass along a wall, six durability tests and the issues left. The C60's new cleaner head (build 38) clears the edges but leaves Eco 3:20 short and the machine 40 g over; the C90's bigger battery and bin win back run time but put it 140 g over; the C45's lighter motor put it within all seven targets. Models, parts, tests and numbers are invented; no real product, technology or factory is named

categorical.name: purple (the subject: the part, model or series the title is about)

data.comparison: #555555 dotted 2 3 (targets and limits), #dadada solid (a past review)

marks.plot-panel: #f7f7f7 behind every plot in sections 01 and 02, the same panel as Figure 1; one neutral ground, colour only on the data marks, never a tinted zone or a tinted table cell
marks.target-window: #ffffff cut out of the panel where both targets are met (Figure 3 only), named in 11.5px/500 #555555 caps, #f7f7f7 grid inside it, a 1px #e6e6e6 frame round the plot
marks.bridge-plan: #ffffff with a dashed 5 3 outline, #d0273b when still over, #7d8083 when under
marks.gap-column: a column from the target line to the value: #333333 when the target is met, #d0273b when missed, on the panel
marks.table-miss: #b0122f value and ✗ on the plain cell

screen.ring: 1.85% of the screen's width, the mode colour
screen.battery: white outline, filled in the mode colour by run time ÷ MIN, full at the MIN or above

validation.tool: dataviz validate_palette.js (OKLab), run 2026-11-25 on white #ffffff and the panel #f7f7f7; the screen colours on #000000
validation.categorical: purple #6b46c1, green #1a8a6e and copper #c26a12 pass every check with --pairs all on #ffffff and #f7f7f7: lightness inside the band, chroma ≥ 0.1, worst CVD pair copper↔green ΔE 9.6 (protan), worst normal-vision pair 21.3, each ≥ 3:1. Text steps: purple #5a3fb0 7.6:1, green #176f59 6.1:1, copper #9a520c 5.9:1. Other is the part grey #d9dbdd
validation.parts: the two colours a part can take, changed purple #6b46c1 and over-budget red #d0273b, pass with --pairs all on #ffffff and #f7f7f7: CVD ΔE 22.2 (protan), normal vision 27.6, both ≥ 3:1. Parts are otherwise #d9dbdd with a #7d8083 edge (3.71:1 on #f7f7f7), so a part never relies on its fill alone
validation.modes: Eco #3fd24a, Auto #2aa3ef and Boost #f0403a on #000000 with --pairs all: CVD 11.2 (deutan), normal vision 29.0, all ≥ 3:1 (5.5–10.5:1). Green and blue sit above the lightness band on purpose, as on the product screens; a mode colour always comes with the mode's name inside the screen
validation.laser: dust #5fe04a on #000000 12.3:1; one colour only, the count is the data
validation.sequential: #b3a0e9 → #4b2d91 passes --ordinal on #ffffff: monotone lightness, every step ≥ 0.06, light end 2.30:1, hue spread 4°
validation.diverging: blue arm #8fb0e4 → #2a64b0 and red arm #ec9aa1 → #a8142c each pass --ordinal on #ffffff (light ends 2.21:1 and 2.16:1); the middle is the neutral #e3e3e3
validation.text: ink #333333 12.6:1, muted #555555 7.5:1 (6.96:1 on #f7f7f7), red text #b0122f 7.1:1, good #1d7a43 5.4:1; #919191 (3.2:1) only for large section numbers and dashes

code.note: the panel grey of the Specifications panel; text steps from the data palette, every token ≥ 4.5:1 on #f7f7f7, line numbers excepted

sans.role: everything: Jost stands in for the geometric sans dyson.com uses (SIL OFL); Korean is Noto Sans KR, the face dyson.co.kr sets beside it. Book 400 for text, Medium 500 for labels, titles, tabs and buttons

display.role: Light 300 for the result sentence, section names, the run times on the round screens (Jost in both languages, like a product screen), spec values, part weights and the dust left behind

mono.role: code only; numbers stay in the sans with tabular figures

scale.headline: 34px/300 (ko 30px), line-height 1.22, two sentences on two lines: what the build did, then what it costs
scale.kicker: 14px/500 #555555: model · build · targets met, the count in red (or green at 7 of 7)
scale.screen: a black circle 164px (150 below 1360, 142 below 1200, a third of the width on phones): the mode 9% of the width in 500 in its colour, the run time 27% in Light 300, a battery 46% wide, 'MIN 60:00' 7.2% #b9b9b9; under it the gap to the MIN 15.5px/500 (red when short, ✓ when not) and last build 13px
scale.spec-row: label 14px/500 with its limit 12.5px #555555 → value 25px/300 with the unit 14px → ✓ or ✗ → 1px #dadada hairline; a miss turns the limit and value red #b0122f
scale.figure-number: 'FIG. 1' 12.5px/500 #555555 letter-spaced .06em, as on a patent drawing (ko '그림 1')
scale.card-title: 19px/500 (ko 17.5px), the result as a sentence; subtitle 14px #555555
scale.balloon: a 19–21px circle, 1px #333333 (purple for a changed part), the part number in 11–12px/500 Jost
scale.part-label: name 14px/500 above the weight in 21px/300 with 'g' 12.5px, the gap to the budget 12.5px (red 500 when over); one line (13px name, 15px weight) when there is no room
scale.section: 30px/300 with its number in #919191 (01 By build), a 15px kicker
scale.table: 14.5px rows with 1px #dadada rules, a 1px #333333 rule under the head, group rows 12.5px/500 letter-spaced, numbers right-aligned and tabular, a miss in red with ✗

rows: header, black, two lines: business and report name with the build and week, EN/KO; then the model tabs (C45 Compact, C60 Standard, C90 Large) like the dyson.com menu row, and the test date and design freeze

first screen (1fr | 478px): left, the kicker and the result in two Light sentences, then the round screens (run time in Eco, Auto and Boost) beside the spec rows (suction, noise, edge pick-up, weight), then Figure 2 laser floor at the foot of the column; right, Figure 1 exploded view on the #f7f7f7 panel with the assembled bar against the MAX. Figure 2 sits at the bottom of its row so the two captions end on one line

01 By build, two rows of 1fr | 1fr (subgrid): Figure 3 gap to target (every build of all three models as a dot: Eco run time minus its MIN across, weight minus its MAX up; a #f7f7f7 panel with a white grid, split by the dash-dot MIN and MAX lines, and only the window inside both targets cut out in white and named; the selected model in #333333 with arrows on long steps and build numbers 32 · 37 · changed builds · 41, the other two in #9e9e9e, points outside a target red, a purple balloon on the step into a build where a part changed) · Figure 4 weight bridge (a horizontal waterfall against the MAX on a #f7f7f7 panel: build 37, each changed part in purple, build 41 in red when over, then the fixes planned for build 42 as dashed white bars and the planned total; dotted connectors; rows at least 44px, totals 22px, steps 18px) · then Figure 5 gap columns (edge pick-up, Eco run time and weight by build: each column runs from the target line to the value, #333333 when met and red when missed, each chart on a #f7f7f7 panel; purple balloons and a dotted line where a part changed, the gap printed on build 37 and the changed builds, build 41's value and gap at the right) · Table 1 builds 37 (review) to 41 (now) against the targets: the build 41 column on a #f7f7f7 band, misses in red with ✗, then parts changed and targets met

02 Tests and what is left (5fr | 7fr, subgrid): Figure 6 durability tests (a #f7f7f7 panel with white month lines; done in #333333, to go in nickel, after freeze in red, bars up to 20px, a solid TODAY line and a dash-dot DESIGN FREEZE line, restarted tests marked by the part's balloon) · Table 2 issues (part balloon, issue with its number in red, fix with its effect, owner, due)
03 Build it yourself: the workbench (files, Figure 1 with and without DASHBOARD.md, the code)
04 How we count: definitions in two columns, then the footer

motion.explode: 0.9s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1): the parts start assembled and slide apart along the axis to their even gaps; brackets fade in at 0.65s, balloons and labels at 0.75s, 40ms a part
motion.ring: 0.9s, each screen's ring draws round, 120ms apart; the battery fills from the left 0.25s later
motion.sweep: 1.1s, a green line crosses each laser floor and the dust lights up behind it
motion.grow: 0.7s, Figure 4 bars grow from the left, 70ms apart
motion.typing: the workbench types its code a line at a time and draws Figure 1 in five layers

tableau.fonts: Tableau Book for text; Jost and Noto Sans KR only if installed on every viewing machine and the server. The exploded view is a Gantt bar on one axis: [Start] = running sum of weights plus a gap, size = weight

measured.date: 2026-11-23 and 2026-11-24, the built-in browser (getComputedStyle at 1440×900): dyson.com home, the cordless vacuum list, a cordless vacuum product page with Specifications open, a cordless vacuum support guide (machineId 381420-01) on the screen and power modes, dyson.co.kr and the terms of use
measured.page: header #000000 (menu 16px Light white), a language strip #242424, a notice strip #0066cc. Text #333333, labels #555555, tertiary #919191, bullets #404040. Hairlines #dadada under spec values, card borders #dcdcdc, sticky cards 1px #eeeeee with 4px corners and a shadow. Panels #fbfbfb (the sample uses #f7f7f7 so the panel holds against white on more screens). Price blue #0066cc 32px/500. Deal button green #79b928 with black 18px/500 text
measured.spec: Specifications panel: label 16/24 500 #555555 → value 36/44 Light 300 #333333 with the unit 24/32 400 on the same line → a 1px #dadada hairline
measured.screens: the cordless vacuum's round screen names the power mode in its colour (Eco green, Auto blue, Boost red), shows the run time left in minutes and seconds and a battery; the cleaner head's green light shows dust on hard floor
measured.views: Dyson explains its machines with exploded views: parts pulled apart along one axis, leaders to their names
measured.type: dyson.com sets a geometric sans (Light 300 for headings and spec values, Book 400, Medium 500); dyson.co.kr sets Noto Sans beside it. Not used: the brand typeface itself; Jost and Noto Sans KR stand in (SIL OFL)
measured.not_used: the Dyson logo and wordmark, the brand typeface, product photos, renders and drawings of the machines, the screen icons, product and technology names, real specifications, run times or test results, factory locations and people
